note: Anguilla, read on the Government of Anguilla's Immigration & Labour pages (gov.ai) on 2026-10-30. Work permits are of four types (self-employed, employee, renewal and temporary); the vacancy is advertised first and the application made at the Labour Department with the employer's papers (an employee's permit read as work for the sponsor); the fee for each position is set by the profession and qualifications and isn't stated, so none is kept, beside an EC$100 processing fee; where an applicant must be isn't stated ('either'). Permanent residence is applied for at the Immigration Main Office under the Revised Regulations of Anguilla 15-3: an EC$150 processing fee and a permit fee of EC$1,000 a year (or EC$2,000 for 2 years, EC$2,500 for 3); kept as EC$1,150 for a one-year permit renewed. Belonger status by grant asks fifteen years' residence; the years the permanent residence permit asks aren't on the page, so none are kept. Decision times aren't stated.

sources.title: Government of Anguilla, Labour: Procedure for Work Permits
sources.said: All vacancies must be advertised before an application can be submitted. ... There are four types of work permits ... Self employed ... Employee ... Renewal and ... Temporary ... There is a fee charged for each position. The fee is determined based on the profession and qualifications. An additional ... processing fee must be paid for each work permit before it is processed.

sources.title: Government of Anguilla, Resident Stamps: Processing of Permanent Residence applications
sources.said: Revised Regulations of Anguilla: 15-3 ... Applications for Permanent Residence can be collected at the Immigration Main Office. ... EC$150.00 ... EC$1,000.00 (payable annually) ... EC$2,000.00 (permit valid for 2 years)
